'''Haaken Baranar''' was a [[free-trader]] and [[Scout/Legends|scout]]. While on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Toola/Legends|Toola]], Baranar was mauled by a [[snow demon]]. Baranar was discovered by the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Spetbecca]], who ran the [[Great Hoary Mastmot Trading Station]]. While Baranar recovered, Spetbecca was captured by [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]]. Baranar took over the running of the trading post when he recovered, keeping it operational in the hope that Spetbecca would one day return.
